Total turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets reached 1.86 trillion yuan, down 104.7 billion from the previous session. Defense sector was active, with Hunan Tianyan hitting the limit up. Additionally, the cultural media sector was weak all day, with Sanrenxing and Publishing Media hitting limit down, while Mango Excellent Media, Liujin Technology, and Duzhe Media all fell sharply. headlines.title_en: Broker rating - JPMorgan: CICC merger-related selloff creates buying opportunity; reiterates 'Overweight' rating
headlines.summary_en: JPMorgan research note: CICC's A-shares and H-shares fell 3% and 7% respectively last session (8th), underperforming A-share and H-share brokerage peers by roughly 2 and 5 percentage points. The bank believes the weakness is driven mainly by merger-related technical factors rather than fundamental deterioration, and current levels can be seen as a buying opportunity; event-driven fund flow impacts should gradually fade as the deal nears completion, while the bank expects CICC's Q3 operating trends to be stronger than peers. CICC has received CSRC approval to merge with Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities; the bank estimates the merger could drag EPS and ROE by high-single-digit to low-double-digit percentages on a static basis, but expects ROE to recover to 11.9% in 2027 as merger synergies (mainly via balance sheet re-leveraging) offset dilution. Q3 results could act as a catalyst, benefiting from relatively higher retail brokerage exposure...

headlines.title: 德国势将为10年期国债发行付出2010年以来最高的收益率
headlines.summary: 德国10年期国债的借贷成本势将达到至少自2010年以来的最高水平，投资者要求对持续高企的通胀和日益加剧的政治不确定性给予更高的补偿。该国财政部将于周三招标发行55亿欧元（64亿美元）将于2036年8月到期的债券。已发行在外10年期国债收益率徘徊在3.38%左右，这将是至少16年来该期限债券发行成本最高的一次。受全球抛售潮的影响，德国国债收益率在过去几周大幅上涨。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Germany set to pay highest yield on 10-year bond issuance since 2010
headlines.summary_en: Germany's 10-year bond borrowing costs are set to reach their highest level since at least 2010, as investors demand greater compensation for persistently elevated inflation and growing political uncertainty. The country's finance agency will auction 5.5 billion euros ($6.4 billion) of bonds maturing in August 2036 on Wednesday. The yield on outstanding 10-year bonds is hovering around 3.38%, which would mark the highest issuance cost for that maturity in at least 16 years. German bond yields have risen sharply over recent weeks amid a global selloff. (Bloomberg)

headlines.title_en: A-share close: Shanghai index up 0.28% on shrinking volume; coal, shipping sectors collectively strengthen
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets diverged in choppy trading all day, with the three major indices mixed. Coal sector rallied collectively, with Yunmei Energy hitting two consecutive limit-ups, Zhengzhou Coal Industry and Dayou Energy hitting limit up. Shipping sector surged, with Nanjing Port, China Merchants Energy Shipping, and Haitian Development hitting limit up. Defense sector moved, with Yaxing Anchor Chain and Hunan Tianyan hitting limit up. Gold stocks were active in the afternoon, with Hunan Gold and Lyshen Tongling hitting limit up. On the downside, media and short-drama concepts adjusted, with Publishing Media and Dasheng Culture hitting limit down; digital currency concept fell, with Cuiwei Share hitting limit down. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with over 3,500 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets turning green; today's turnover was 1.87 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.28%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.15%, and ChiNext fell 0.14%. 2. headlines.title_en: A-share close: Shanghai index opens high, rises 0.28%; coal mining, port shipping, lab-grown diamond sectors lead gains
headlines.summary_en: A-share three major indices ended mixed today; at close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.28%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.15%, ChiNext fell 0.14%, Beijing Stock Exchange 50 fell 0.41%, and STAR 50 fell 0.69%. Total market turnover reached 1,873.1 billion yuan, down 105.2 billion from the previous session, with over 3,600 stocks falling across the market. By sector theme, coal mining and processing, lab-grown diamonds, port shipping, components, and precious metals led gains; cultural media, gaming, AI corpus, short-drama gaming, and AI video led losses. On the board, the coal mining and processing sector was strong all day, with Yunmei Energy, Zhengzhou Coal Industry, and Dayou Energy hitting limit up, while Huayang Shares, Jinneng Holding Coal Industry, and Shanxi Coal International led gains. Precious metals rallied in the afternoon, with Hunan Gold touching limit up, while Zhongjin Gold, Xiaocheng Technology, and Inner Mongolia Xingye Silver and Tin led gains. headlines.title: 长三角地区海关创新构建政策支持体系
headlines.summary: 记者从上海海关了解到，今年前8个月，长三角地区实现进出口13.16万亿元人民币，比去年同期增长18.8%，占同期全国进出口总值的37.8%，规模创历史新高。围绕长三角外贸一体化高质量发展需求，长三角地区海关（包括上海、南京、杭州、宁波、合肥海关）持续创新构建政策支持体系。(新华社)
headlines.title_zh: 长三角地区海关创新构建政策支持体系

headlines.title_en: Customs in the Yangtze River Delta region innovate to build a policy support system.
headlines.summary_en: A reporter learned from Shanghai Customs that in the first eight months of this year, the Yangtze River Delta region achieved imports and exports of 13.16 trillion yuan, up 18.8% year-on-year, accounting for 37.8% of the national total for the period, setting a record high. To support the high-quality development of foreign trade integration in the Yangtze River Delta, customs in the region (including Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Ningbo, and Hefei customs) continue to innovate and build a policy support system. (Xinhua)
